question: Which company developed CoviSelf, a self-testing kit for the COVID-19 infection?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mylab**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Mylab** Discovery Solutions developed CoviSelf, the first self-use COVID-19 test kit in India.
 
• CoviSelf was approved by the Indian Council of Medical Research (**ICMR**) in May 2021.
 
• This self-testing kit allows individuals to test for COVID-19 infection at home and provides results within 15 minutes.
 
• CoviSelf uses a rapid antigen test method, which is a quick and efficient way to detect the presence of the virus.
 
• The kit includes all necessary components such as a nasal swab, pre-filled extraction tube, and test card.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rapid Antigen Tests (RAT)**

 
 
• **Rapid antigen tests** are point-of-care tests that detect the presence of viral proteins in a sample.
 
• These tests are known for their quick turnaround time, providing results in as little as 15 minutes.
 
• They are widely used for mass testing, especially during pandemics due to their ease of use and rapid results.
 
• However, they are less sensitive compared to** RT-PCR tests,** which can lead to a higher rate of false negatives.
 
 
 
• **Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR)**
 
 
• ICMR is the apex body in India for the formulation, coordination, and promotion of biomedical research.
 
• It is one of the oldest medical research bodies in the world, **established in 1911.**
 
• ICMR played a crucial role in the approval and validation of various COVID-19 testing kits and vaccines during the pandemic.
 
 
 
• **Nasal Swab Test**
 
 
• A nasal swab test involves collecting a sample from the nasal cavity using a swab.
 
• This method is commonly used for the diagnosis of respiratory infections, including COVID-19.
 
• The swab is then tested for the presence of viral RNA or proteins to confirm infection.
 
 
 
• **Self-Testing Kits**
 
 
• Self-testing kits empower individuals to conduct tests at home without the need for a healthcare professional.
 
• These kits are designed to be user-friendly and include clear instructions for sample collection and result interpretation.
 
• Self-testing helps in early detection and isolation of infected individuals, thereby reducing the spread of the virus.
